title: Project Experience
description: My experience comes from designing and developing real-world personal projects that allowed me to apply modern software development practices, solve practical problems, and build production-ready applications. While I have not yet worked professionally, these projects have provided valuable hands-on experience.

experience.description: An AI-powered, semester-wise learning platform built exclusively for BCA students — featuring an intelligent chat workspace, structured syllabus browser, and auth-gated AI assistance.
highlights: Semester-wise syllabus browser (Sem 1 to Sem 6) with accordion-style navigation
AI-driven chat workspace powered by locally-hosted qwen3:8b LLM via Ollama
Implementing popup-based authentication flows with Clerk in React without standalone auth routes
Prompt engineering for custom AI personas and response behavior with open-source LLMs

experience.description: A comprehensive, privacy-first browser-based image processing suite — featuring compression, format conversion, resizing, and cropping with zero server communication and support for 15+ image formats.
highlights: Image Compressor — reduce file sizes by up to 90% with smart quality detection
Target Size Compression — compress to a specific file size using binary search algorithm
Deep understanding of the HTML5 Canvas API for image rendering, manipulation, and format-specific encoding
Browser memory management patterns for large file processing (object URL lifecycle, canvas cleanup)

experience.description: A premium, bilingual (Hindi + English) workforce hiring ecosystem built in PHP — connecting verified Workers, Businesses, and Contractor Partners with KYC verification workflows, digital wallet systems, and a multi-tier user architecture inspired by Digital India.
highlights: Multi-role architecture — Workers, Businesses, Partners, and Admin
Designing complex multi-role platform architectures with distinct user journeys and shared admin oversight
PHP reusable template architecture using server-side includes for consistent multi-page websites
Bilingual web design — integrating Hindi Devanagari text with English in a cohesive responsive layout
